title: Watercolor 143 Buttercup St
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Per WaterColor HOA, all guests 5 years of age or older must be included in your adult guest total in order to receive wristbands to access amenities and pools. This home is allotted 10 wristbands.- Located in desirable WaterColor- Access to neighborhood pools, beach club, playground, and nature trails- Professionally decorated- Screened porch- Parking for 2 Vehicles- 3 adult bikes- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutGuests staying in WaterColor will have access to the newly expanded WaterColor Beach Club. It features a new main pool and lounge area, a second pool deck with additional lounge seating, a third pool with zero-entry, enhanced WaterColor Grill, and a new sunset bar, Costa Chica. All have scenic views of the Gulf of Mexico.DETAILS: Welcome to 143 Buttercup! This coastal classic 3-bedroom, 3.5-bathroom home in WaterColor features modern, updated interiors and appliances throughout the home with natural light shining through to create an open and airy feel. The home is located in the award-winning community of WaterColor, with a beach club, neighborhood pools, tennis courts, parks, and nature trails all around you. The first floor has an open living area and kitchen with a laundry room attached. The dining table can seat 8 guests for a meal. There is also a patio and screened porch on the first floor with extra outdoor seating. The primary bedroom is down the hall and features a king bed and private bathroom with a bathtub and shower. The second floor has its own living area overlooking the balcony with floor-to-ceiling windows. The next guest room has 2 twin-over-full bunk beds with twin trundles and private bathroom. The last room features 2 queen beds with a private bathroom attached and balcony access. Take the bikes for a ride through the neighborhood to the nearby Gulf for a quick, scenic adventure! There are boutiques, restaurants, and more to be discovered at WaterColor and the neighboring Seaside. Don't miss your chance to stay at 143 Buttercup!FIRST FLOOR:Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and Tub Separate SECOND FLOOR:Guest Bedroom: Two Twin-over-Full Bunk Beds with Twin Trundles, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboGuest Bedroom: Two Queen Beds, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboPlease note: Effective March 15, 2014, Low-Speed Vehicle rentals in WaterColor must be made through The Electric Cart Company and will be limited to 60 vehicles throughout the community at any given time. Only one cart may be rented per home, and rentals will be granted on a first-come, first-served basis.*Unfortunately no pets allowed in this home at any time.
